claims.text: The Sungai Liang Cracker in Brunei is an ethane-based steam cracker operated by Coral Bay Olefins.
The Sungai Liang Cracker is located in Sungai Liang, Brunei.
The Sungai Liang Cracker is reported as operating as of 2024.
The capacity of the Sungai Liang Cracker is not publicly confirmed.

coverage_note: Only one ethane-based steam cracker is identified in Southeast Asia, with limited public confirmation of capacity.
